assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina, STAR + RSEM) of 3D donor-derived human myobundles (S2.6.p1)
sample_inclusion: 12 myobundle chips, all electrically stimulated (E-Stim, 3 V/mm, 2 ms, 2 Hz, 2x30 min/day, days 14-21): Young active (YA) vehicle n=3, YA tomatidine n=3, Old sedentary (OS) vehicle n=3, OS tomatidine n=3 (Table 1; S2.5.p1; S3.1.p1)

stimulation: E-Stim only; no unstimulated RNA-seq arm

primary_estimand: Effect of tomatidine vs vehicle on gene expression in E-Stim myobundles, separately within YA- and OS-derived myobundles (S2.7.p1; S3.2.p1). The paper's RNA-seq does not estimate the effect of exercise-like stimulation itself: every sequenced sample was stimulated.
planned_contrasts: YA tomatidine vs YA vehicle, both E-Stim (S3.2.p1; paper: 215 up / 219 down = 434 DEGs)
OS tomatidine vs OS vehicle, both E-Stim (S3.2.p1; paper: 12 up / 2 down = 14 DEGs)
repeated_measure_unit: none; each chip is one independent myobundle; donor cell lines pooled per cohort (one YA and one OS donor source)
normalization: RSEM gene quantification; low average counts excluded (S2.6.p1)
paper_method: DESeq2 on RSEM counts, tomatidine vs matched control per cohort (S2.6.p1; S2.7.p1)
paper_results: YA 215 up / 219 down; OS 12 up / 2 down; GSEA KEGG JAK/STAT; IL6 ~5-fold and CXCL8 ~1.6-fold up in YA tomatidine (S3.2.p1, S3.2.p3)
